Interpretation: Papers with a recorded preprint dated before the submission deadline had about 1.8x the odds of acceptance compared with papers with no recorded pre-submission preprint, after adjusting for institution tier, country, and year.
Submissions whose first author comes from a top-20 CS-ranked institute had about 11.9x the odds of acceptance of submissions from bottom-ranked institutes (top vs bottom).
China-affiliated submissions had about 0.73x the odds of acceptance of US-affiliated submissions (pairwise coefficient, China vs US).
Joint Wald test that all country-group coefficients are jointly zero, after adjusting for preprint visibility, institution tier, and year.
Later ICLR years show much lower acceptance odds than 2023 (2025 OR=0.26, about 74% lower odds), reflecting stronger competition or changing acceptance rates over time.
